topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I stumbled upon my words, my thoughts, laid bare on a public platform, a stark example for others to scrutinize. My essay, once a private confession to the universe, now a shared story, stripped of its secrets. I thought I had hit send to just one place, a singular audience, the admissions board. But now, it’s out there, a permanent mark in the digital realm. My hands tremble slightly as I scroll through the comments, each one a judgment, a critique. What if they see something I didn’t intend? What if this changes everything? Every word, once a part of me, now seems to mock the silence I can’t escape.
